title: Kit Bodega's outfit for cats!
description: Gives cats the outfit used by Kit from Gameover!
body:
# What is this?
This is a resource pack that changes the adult cats textures and adds Kit Bodega's outfit from Gameoverse.
# Why does this pack exists?
I created this resource pack simply because I just wanted to see how cute the cats could be in her outfit.
# Credits
Credits for Glitch Productions and RubberRoss, creator of Gameoverse.
